title: Pulsed Electromagentic Field in Haemophilia
brief_summary: To assess the effect of pulsed electero- magnetic field on swelling, range of motion and muscle strength of hemarthrotic knee joints of haemophilic subjects.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* type A hemophilia (moderate)
* free from any musculoskeletal deformities.

Exclusion Criteria:

* patients who performed surgical procedures 6 weeks before conducting the study
